hero.lede: Full-stack TypeScript engineer with 10+ years shipping React, Next.js and Node.js products — from real-time telecom dashboards to booking engines and headless CMSs.

work.name: NetAI
work.summary: Real-time dashboards that turn 10K+ network metrics and ML predictions into something an operator can act on.
work.problem: Telecom operators were diagnosing network anomalies by hand across huge, noisy datasets.
work.approach: Next.js dashboards over strictly typed API clients, with caching tuned for large telemetry pulls and WebSocket streams.

work.name: Skipper
work.summary: A React CMS that lets hotels edit their own sites, rendering through custom Svelte templates.
work.problem: Hotel teams needed to update content without a developer in the loop.
work.approach: React admin built on JSON-schema forms, content pulled from a Django REST backend, rendered by swappable Svelte templates.

work.name: Hazard County Shuttle
work.summary: Trailhead-to-trailhead bike and river shuttles — trails, meeting points, galleries and a booking flow.

work.name: Plume
work.summary: Reusable view blocks and custom templates on a headless CMS, visually tested in Storybook across every breakpoint.

work.name: Keys & Quests

work.name: BetterNotion
work.summary: One page's data rendered through Table, Kanban, Timeline and Calendar views, all driven by a single JSON contract from the backend.

work.name: Folia
